messages:
maria_ops: APAC provisioning gap — vendor RMA hit a customs hold, we just lost ~8 H100 slots for the next wave. Need options: expedite, loaner pool, or credit. Sharing details below.
kevin_procs: What's the ETA on the RMA? Any tracking we can surface?
maria_ops: Vendor provided AWB `SF123456789CN` — stuck at SGS Shenzhen, docs flagged for HS reclassification. Vendor offering either partial air rebook at +$4k/unit or access to a loaner pool (12 units) on ~2-week term.
lee_fleet: Loaners preferable to keep services up. Firmware parity and KV cache compatibility is a hard requirement though — any mismatch will break hot-standby.
olga_vendor: Confirmed — customs flagged HS code. We can push loaners ASAP but need LOA + PO amendment. Expedite air option is available at the premium maria mentioned. Alternatively we can split: 6 expedite + loaners for the remainder.
toni_logistics: If loaner route, depot/RMA paperwork + customs LOA needed. I can draft but need AWB + commercial invoice copy.
kevin_procs: Do we have an estimate of total cost delta (expedite vs loaner + deposit + courier)? Also let's ask for a SLA credit given the delay.
olga_vendor: Expedite estimate: ~$4k/unit air + broker fee ~$500/unit. Loaner: no per-unit air fee but refundable damage deposit $2k/unit + inbound/outbound courier billed at cost. Vendor can offer 15% credit on units delayed beyond SLA threshold (3 business days).
maria_ops: Proposal: accept loaner for 8 units to protect capacity, request the 15% credit, insist on firmware parity and full serial/firmware trace logs before depot handoff, and start PO amendment. @olga_vendor can you provide an LOA template and confirm loaner ship ETA?
olga_vendor: LOA template will be posted by EOD here. Loaner ship ETA: outbound in ~36h once LOA/PO amendment is signed; original RMA likely clears in ~5-7 business days after docs. I'll post AWB updates when available.
rma_bot: RMA ticket RMA-89234 updated: status = "Docs requested by customs", assignee = olga_vendor, est_resolution = 2026-03-27.
lee_fleet: Tag loaner units in inventory as `loaner-apac-1715` and restrict to priority queues only. Need depot acceptance checklist: serial whitelist + firmware checksum.
toni_logistics: I'll prepare LOA + customs letter and the depot checklist. @maria_ops please approve wording when I share. Also need to know whether we accept vendor courier or use our forwarder.
maria_ops: Approved to proceed with LOA wording once drafted. Also implement canary routing: route 50% of APAC GPU requests to eu-surge for non-latency-critical jobs — reduces risk while loaners come online. @kevin_procs please run quick cost/latency sim.
kevin_procs: Running sim now, will post numbers in ~2hrs. Preliminary thought: EU routing increases cost by ~12% on token billing but keeps latency for batch jobs within SLOs.
maria_ops: Great, thanks. Let's keep comms tight. If vendor posts LOA/AWB updates drop them here. :thumbsup:
